div.head: Af El. 49.5
div.ab: Ðæm halgan Gaste wæs geþuht ond us, ðæt we nane byrþene on eow setton noldon ofer ðæt ðe eow nydðearf wæs to healdene: ðæt is þonne, ðæt ge forberan, þæt ge diofolgyld ne wurðian, ne blod ne ðicgan ne asmorod, ond from dyrnum geligerum; ond ðæt ge willan, ðæt oþre men eow ne don, ne do ge ðæt oðrum monnum.’

Þæm halgan Gaste wæs geðuht ⁊ ús, þæt we nane byrðenne on eow settan noldon ofer þæt ðe eow nedðearf wæs to healdanne: þæt [is] ðonne, þæt ge forberen, þæt ge deofolgeld ne weorðien, ne blod ne ðicggen ne asmorod, ⁊ from diernum geligerum; ⁊ þæt ge willen, þæt oðre men eow ne don, ne doð ge ðæt oþrum monnum.’

Uisum est enim Spiritui sancto et nobis, nichil ultra imponere uobis oneris quam hec necessario: ut abstineatis uos ab immolatis simulacrorum et sanguine et suffocato et fornicatione. A quibus custodientes uos, bene agetis. Valete.’ Quod uobis non uultis fieri, non faciatis alii.

Þæm halgan Gaste wæs geðuht ⁊ ús, þæt we nane byrðenne on eow settan noldon ofer þæt ðe eow nedðearf wæs to healdanne: þæt [is] ðonne, þæt ge forberen, þæt ge deofolgeld ne weorðien, ne blod ne ðicggen ne asmorod, ⁊ from diernum geligerum; ⁊ þæt ge willen, þæt oðre men eów ne don, ne doð ge ðæt oþrum monnum.

It seemed to the Holy Ghost and to us, that we did not wish to impose on you any burden beyond what was needful to hold: that is, then, that you abandon the worship of devils, that you taste neither blood nor strangled [animals], and [that you keep] from [engagement in] fornication; and what you wish that other men not do to you, do not to other men.”

Dem Heiligen Geiste und uns dünkte [richtig], dass wir keine Bürde auf euch legen wollten, über das hinaus, was zu halten euch nothwendig wäre: das heisst nämlich, dass ihr abstehet, Götzen anzubeten, Blut zu geniessen oder Ersticktes, und von unehelichen Buhlereien. Und was ihr wollet, dass andere Leute euch nicht thun, thuet ihr das auch anderen Leuten nicht.’

It seemed [right] to the Holy Spirit and to us that we should lay no burden upon you beyond what it would be necessary for you to keep: that is to say, that you refrain from worshipping idols, from consuming blood or what is strangled, and from fornication outside marriage. And what you wish other people not to do to you, do not do that to other people either.’
